UI_optionscreen_binding_LSW Find Item: Find an item you have seen
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_Description: Search for items by name among the places your character has seen them. The key to open the search window is in Key Bindings, under Last Seen Where (Ctrl + F by default). These settings are yours alone; a server can make everyone use one search rule.
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_SearchRule_tooltip: What the search window looks through. What I have seen: only containers and floors your character has looked at. Shared: also what the members of your faction and safehouse have seen (multiplayer). Opened by anyone: every container anyone has opened, and anything anyone has seen. Everything: all of that plus every container and floor around you right now, even ones you have not looked at (containers nobody has opened yet hold nothing). If the server picks a rule for everyone, this setting is ignored.
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_SearchRule_Shared: Shared with my faction and safehouse
UI_TienLastSeenWhere_ArrowColour_tooltip: Colour and opacity of the arrow on the floor, the target marker and the small arrows in the search window.
